answer: The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pearl of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
